hero.subtitle: Private Leagues for predicting CS2 Matches at the Major and other pro Events. Predictions stay hidden until everyone is in.
hero.badge: Sign in with Telegram, no password needed

league.title: Create a League
league.text: Pick an Event, name your League and share the Invite Link in your chat.

predict.title: Predict every Match
predict.text: One tap on the team you think will win. Change your mind until the Match Locks, 15 minutes before it starts.

reveal.title: Reveal together
reveal.text: Nobody sees your Prediction until everyone has predicted or the Match Locks. No copying.

leaderboard.title: Climb the Leaderboard
leaderboard.text: 1 Point for every correct Prediction, and a separate Pick'em for each Stage.
